consequence.statement: Logs RBAC is enforced by default; the logs tab on pod view is not visible to users/groups/roles without explicit `logs, get` permission.
consequence.remediation: Grant explicit `logs, get` permissions to the users/groups/roles that need log access; remove server.rbac.log.enforce.enable from argocd-cm after upgrade.

assertion.statement: Starting in 3.0 the argocd-cm flag server.rbac.log.enforce.enable is removed and logs RBAC is always enforced, so the logs tab on pod view is hidden unless users have explicit `logs, get` permission.
